mission: Complete the next unresolved stateful fact. Do not regenerate or rethink the entire Stateful Surface Ledger when one evidence gap is enough.

productiveActions: inspect one of the exact files named by the current gap
update only the current surface artifact with repository evidence
record an exact blocker with an executable next action
nonProductiveExamples: repeating that the ledger will be written
re-reading the whole ledger without a new evidence question
debating formatting or CRLF noise after semantic equality is established
planning adjacent surfaces that the router did not select

lineEndingNoisePolicy.rule: Out-of-scope CRLF/LF-only changes are noise, not owned work. Restore them immediately after proving there is no semantic diff.
lineEndingNoisePolicy.refuseWhen: git diff --ignore-space-at-eol reports semantic content changes

globalForbidden: Do not rewrite the complete ledger to answer one evidence question.
Do not select or introduce a serverless provider during evidence gathering.
Do not modify product/runtime code from an EVIDENCE_REQUIRED task.
Do not edit more than one stateful surface artifact per routed task.
Do not promote proof above the current surface proofCeiling.
Do not hide application behavior in prompts, skills, or reports.
completionRule: The router advances only after the selected evidence gap is resolved, the per-surface top-level status matches remaining gaps, and its focused validator passes. Blocked gaps stop routing at that surface. When a surface reaches READY_FOR_DECISION, the decision task records the canonical ledger decision and then marks the per-surface artifact COMPLETED; COMPLETED closes only the evidence/decision routing loop and does not claim migration implementation or runtime proof.
